title: Seville Sunset Ballon ride.
text: A brilliant experience! We enjoyed every minute and the staff were fantastic. So friendly and reassuring. I would definitely recommend, and say book it, if you are considering. You won’t regret it.
author: sophierJ9322AB

title: Wonderful Team - Tremendous Experience
text: This was our first ballooning experience, and so we had some fear and concerns regarding safety. The ballooning over the course of the experience put our fears to rest through their safety briefings and their ongoing updates from rigging up the balloon to how to best enjoy the flight experience. The (Champaign) baptism and the certificate at the end were a great cap on the experience. Thank you guys. I would definitely "fly" with you again.
author: Garfield_D

title: Unbeatable experience!!
text: I gifted this experience to my partner for their birthday, and it was wonderful; they loved it. It was a total success to see the sunrise while riding in a balloon, the sunflower fields, and witnessing the setup was very, very cool. At the end, a good breakfast with a toast, diploma, and baptism; simply spectacular service. I recommend it to everyone to experience something as beautiful as this. A thousand thanks to the entire GLOOBO team for their treatment; the pilot Vicente was truly amazing!
author: morenaj153
